_comment: Example settings for rank_jobs.py: an entry-level software engineer near Atlanta on F-1 OPT. Setup writes your own copy to profile/rank_config.json. All patterns are Python regular expressions matched against lowercase text.
_site_order: Order of the site groups in the CSV. A job found on several sites is listed under the first one. Sites not listed go last.
_max_age_hours: Drop jobs posted longer ago than this, per site. Add "default" for sites not listed. Career-site jobs stay open for weeks.
_min_fit: Main quality bar. Raise it if lists get too long.

titles.include: software|developer|full.?stack|front.?end|back.?end|\bsde\b|\bsdet\b|programmer|new grad|graduate|early career|\bai\b|artificial intelligence|genai|machine learning eng|\bml engineer|forward deployed|ci/cd|devops|automation engineer|\bqa\b|quality engineer|engineer in test|platform engineer|application engineer|web engineer|engineer i\b|engineer 1\b|engineer asc
titles.exclude: senior|distinguished|\bsr\b|staff|principal|\blead\b|manager|director|architect|\biii\b|\biv\b|\b[3-5]\b|intern\b|internship|co-?op|consultant|specialist|technician|salesforce|servicenow|peoplesoft|\bsas\b|\bsap\b|\btpm\b|ui/ux|controls|field service|manufacturing|administrator|robotics systems|\bgtm\b|ignition|power platform|instrumentation|navigation|sales engineer|\bphp\b|research engineer|traveling|month-long|mainframe|operations management|\bphd\b|reverse engineer|mid.?level|experienced|cobol|\.net developer|part.?time|contract|tutor|teacher|instructor|trainer|hardware|electrical|mechanical|firmware|embedded|fpga|verification|network engineer|sre\b|site reliability|data engineer|data scientist|ios|android|unity|game|lustre|gpu|diagnostics
titles._comment: include: a title must match this. exclude: drop if it matches. exclude_unless_core: drop unless the title also matches core. role_bonus: +8 fit when the title names the main role.

seniority.desc_bonus: new grad|recent graduate|entry.level|0.?[-–]\s*2 years|0\+? years|no experience
seniority._comment: max_years: drop jobs asking for more years than this (null = no limit). years_bonus: fit points by the minimum years asked. title_bonus +12, desc_bonus +6, title_penalty -6.

_skills: Fit points for each skill the description mentions. Weights here add up to 25.
_min_salary: Annual. Drop jobs whose top of range is below this; jobs with no salary are kept and flagged. null turns it off.

work_authorization._comment: status: us_citizen, green_card, f1_opt (drops citizen-only, green-card-only and no-OPT jobs; flags no-sponsorship) or needs_sponsorship (also drops jobs that won't sponsor a visa). exclude_clearance_jobs: drop jobs that need a security clearance.

locations._comment: Tiers are checked in order; the first match wins. match: regex on the lowercase location. state_codes: matches ', GA' style codes. remote: tier for remote jobs (null drops them). other: tier for everything else (null drops it).

_exclude_companies: Extra regex of company names to drop, on top of the built-in staffing and OPT-placement firm list.
_flags: Note label -> regex checked on the title and start of the description. Matches are noted, not dropped.
